alert_rules_scope_owner_check.name: alert_rules_scope_owner_check
alert_rules_scope_owner_check.value:
("alert_rules"."scope" = 'workspace' AND "alert_rules"."workspace_id" IS NOT NULL AND "alert_rules"."job_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("alert_rules"."scope" = 'job' AND "alert_rules"."job_id" IS NOT NULL AND "alert_rules"."workspace_id" IS NULL)

job_templates_builtin_owner_check.name: job_templates_builtin_owner_check
job_templates_builtin_owner_check.value:
("job_templates"."built_in" = 1 AND "job_templates"."workspace_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("job_templates"."built_in" = 0 AND "job_templates"."workspace_id" IS NOT NULL)
